Use case: scientific-educational. Production asset sprite sheet for the pea genetics mobile game in reference. EXACTLY FOUR equal square cells in one HORIZONTAL row, total aspect ratio 4:1. Clear round versus wrinkled phenotype, no dents on smooth seeds and deep irregular creases on wrinkled ones.

Use case: background-extraction. Extract/reconstruct a SINGLE thin winding pea vine with leaves to decorate paper UI corners, matching exactly the botanical vine corner ornaments on the reference game screens. True transparent alpha. Portrait narrow composition: one very slender undulating stem running from lower left toward upperright, with 9-12 small distinct sage olive pea leaves and curling tendrils, a tiny white pea blossom near lowerthird, gentle natural asymmetry.
